messages.unwritten: Write the customer-facing words before recording copy review; a business name alone is not a post.
messages.notes: Replace internal research or planning notes with customer-facing copy. Keep the source evidence in the website research panel.
messages.question: Add a useful explanation after the hook. Questions alone are not a complete post.
messages.quotation: Write original customer-facing copy; a quotation alone is source material, not a finished post.
messages.cta: Add a relevant call to action before recording copy review.
